text: Billing acceptance criteria are written. Before touching AWS, this video draws a hard line around what version one actually ships.
V1 builds real-time capture and cleaning, plus the Gold billing table that fixes Harlan Voss's problem -- and, nearly for free, a daily performance table nobody acts on yet.
Proactive maintenance alerts, a field-ops dashboard, and predictive scoring are all deferred to v2, on the record -- not forgotten, just not now.
When Desmond asks for alerts anyway, the answer isn't no -- it's that the data will exist, but someone still has to design the threshold and the notification. He agrees: first item in v2.
Next: the first real architecture decision -- why Kinesis, Glue, and Redshift, not a bigger spreadsheet.
